seedPolicy: One new reserved 32-bit seed interval, separate from observed experiment ranges and final B+C next seed 10170081. Smoke seeds are excluded.
comparisonFamily: Three AQ win rates, two G421 direct head-to-head win rates, and two paired differences versus common AQ; seven simultaneous two-sided intervals, Bonferroni seed-block Student t.
stoppingRule: Fixed 512 independent seed blocks with both seats per matchup. 5120 complete four-win matches total. No interim estimates, model selection, or early stopping based on results. Abort on missing or invalid evidence.
interpretation: Research only, no promotion. The direct H2H and improvement versus a common opponent are different estimands. Small differences may remain inconclusive.
